explication: This tree is a small slice of the Nextcloud Docker image repository: versioned PHP configuration fragments for Apache, FPM, and Alpine FPM images. The documented deployment flow is to run an image, route HTTP traffic directly to Apache or through an external web server to FPM, and use environment-driven configuration for Nextcloud. The sampled source confirms app search paths; other configuration capabilities are evident from filenames and README headings, but their implementations and wiring are not shown here.
